title: Why Marathon Petroleum Stock Is Breaking Out To Fresh All-Time Highs Today - Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC)
summary: Iran's escalated geopolitical tensions and threats have revived market-relevant risks in energy markets, particularly impacting refining margins and fuel demand. Marathon Petroleum, a major downstream energy company, has seen a positive market impact due to these developments, with its stock reaching new all-time highs amidst a strong bullish trend.
sentiment_reason: The article indicates a positive sentiment due to the support for Marathon Petroleum's core refining business amidst war risk and geopolitical tensions, which have led to stronger crack spreads and improved fuel demand.
